# Setup script

This part contains connection function and necessary packages used in
the notebook. If this becomes to exhaustive, it can be added to a
separate script.

```{r}
library(inbolims)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(giscoR)
library(n2khab)
library(ggplot2)
library(purrr)
library(scales)
```

```{r}
veldwerk_connect <- function(dbname = "your_default_db") {
  # Read credentials from environment variables (.Renviron)
  host <- Sys.getenv("VELDWERK_HOST")
  port <- Sys.getenv("VELDWERK_PORT")
  user <- Sys.getenv("VELDWERK_USER")
  pass <- Sys.getenv("VELDWERK_PASS")
  
  # Check to ensure credentials are set
  if (host == "" || user == "" || pass == "") {
    stop("Database credentials are missing. Check your .Renviron file.")
  }
  
  DBI::dbConnect(
    drv      = RPostgres::Postgres(),
    dbname   = dbname,
    host     = host,
    port     = port,
    user     = user,
    password = pass
  )
}
```

# Location Evaluation

```{sql}
--| connection: con_le
--| output.var: all_locevals

WITH BASE AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_AsText(LOC.wkb_geometry) AS wkb_geometry
    , LOC.grts_address
    , LOC.location_id
    , SU.sampleunit_id
    , V.date_visit
    , V.type
    , V.type_assessed
    , V.notes
    , V.issues
    , V.visit_done
    , SU.is_replaced
    , SU.type_is_absent
    , R.grts_address_replacement
    , R.is_selected
    , unnest(string_to_array(SU.schemes, '|')) AS scheme
    , 1 as loceval
    , CASE
        WHEN V.issues THEN 0
        WHEN SU.type_is_absent THEN  0
        ELSE 1
      END AS loceval_approved
  FROM "metadata"."Locations" LOC
  INNER JOIN "inbound"."Visits" V
  ON LOC.location_id = V.location_id AND LOC.grts_address = V.grts_address
  INNER JOIN "outbound"."SampleUnits" SU
  ON V.sampleunit_id = SU.sampleunit_id
  LEFT JOIN "outbound"."Replacements" R
  ON SU.replacement_id = R.replacement_id
  WHERE V.visit_done
  -- AND SU.schemes LIKE '%GW_03.3%'
)

SELECT * 
FROM BASE
WHERE scheme IN ('GW_03.3', 'SOIL_03.2', 'SURF_03.4_lentic')
```

```{r}
gw_locevals <- all_locevals |>
  filter(scheme == 'GW_03.3')
```

```{r}
loceval_overview <- all_locevals |>
  summarise(
    total_locevals_over_schemes = n(),
    distinct_locevals = n_distinct(location_id, sampleunit_id),
    distinct_locations = n_distinct(grts_address)
  )

loceval_overview
```

**Locevals by scheme**

```{r}
loceval_by_scheme <- all_locevals |>
  group_by(scheme) |>
  summarise(
    nr_locevals = sum(loceval),
    distinct_locations = n_distinct(grts_address),
    nr_approved_locevals = sum(loceval_approved)
  )
loceval_by_scheme
```

**Locevals by category**

```{r}
loceval_by_category <- all_locevals |>
  group_by(issues, type_is_absent, is_replaced) |>
  summarise(
    nr_locevals = sum(loceval),
    nr_approved_locevals = sum(loceval_approved),
    distinct_locations = n_distinct(grts_address),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(issues), type_is_absent, is_replaced)
loceval_by_category
```

Interpretation:

- `issues = TRUE`: problematic visit; status undecided (in progress).
- `type_is_absent = FALSE`, `is_replaced = FALSE`: expected type
  present, no replacement –\> approved
- `type_is_absent = FALSE`, `is_replaced = TRUE`: expected type present
  with a local replacement –\> approved
- `type_is_absent = TRUE`, `is_replaced = FALSE`: expected type absent
  without possible replacement

Type assessment validation (some rows have inconsistent data)\
–\> in the report we use the above interpretation

```{r}
loceval_inconsistent_data <- all_locevals |>
  filter(
    !issues,
    (
      (!type_is_absent & (is.na(type_assessed) | !coalesce(str_detect(type_assessed, fixed(type)) | str_detect(type, fixed(type_assessed)), FALSE))) |
        (type_is_absent & type == type_assessed)
    )
  ) |>
  select(
    scheme, grts_address, sampleunit_id, type, type_assessed, type_is_absent,
    is_replaced, date_visit, notes
  ) |>
  arrange(scheme, date_visit)
loceval_inconsistent_data
```

# Groundwater fieldwork

## Total executed installations

An executed installation is linked to a field calendar that

- is not excluded
- has a completed visit,
- and has no reported issue.

```{sql}
--| connection: con_gw
--| output.var: gw_installations

SELECT
  IV.location_id,
  IV.sampleunit_id,
  IV.grts_address,
  IV.date_visit,
  IV.stratum,
  IV.watina_code_used_1_peilbuis,
  IV.watina_code_used_2_piezometer
FROM "inbound"."InstallationVisits" AS IV
INNER JOIN "outbound"."FieldCalendars" AS FC
  ON IV.fieldcalendar_id = FC.fieldcalendar_id
WHERE NOT IV.issues
  AND IV.visit_done
  AND NOT FC.excluded
ORDER BY IV.date_visit DESC
```

```{r}
gw_installation_summary <- gw_installations |>
  summarise(
    # nr_installation_rows = n(),
    nr_sample_units = n_distinct(sampleunit_id),
    nr_locations = n_distinct(grts_address),
    nr_piezometers = n_distinct(watina_code_used_2_piezometer, na.rm = TRUE),
    nr_peilbuizen = n_distinct(watina_code_used_1_peilbuis, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
gw_installation_summary
```

## Installation counts by domain and typegroup

### Domains

The domain mapping below groups fieldwork locations into the reporting
areas. Locations without a domain part are excluded from the grouped
summary.

```{sql}
--| connection: con_gw
--| output.var: gw_domains

SELECT 
    DISTINCT grts_address, domain_part,
    CASE 
        WHEN domain_part = 'BE2100015' THEN 'Kalmthoutse Heide'
        WHEN domain_part = 'BE2100024' THEN 'Turnhouts Vennengebied'
        WHEN domain_part = 'BE2200028' THEN 'Mechelse Heide'
        WHEN domain_part = 'BE2200035' THEN 'Voerstreek'
        WHEN domain_part = 'BE2200039' THEN 'De Maten'
        WHEN domain_part = 'Flanders_remainder' THEN 'Overig Vlaanderen'
        WHEN domain_part = 'SAC_network_remainder' THEN 'Overig SBZ-H'
        ELSE domain_part
    END AS domain_name
FROM "outbound"."SampleUnits"
WHERE schemes = 'GW_03.3'
AND domain_part IS NOT NULL
```

### Typegroup

```{sql}
--| connection: con_gw

FROM "metadata"."N2kHabStrata"
```

### Lims

```{sql}
--| connection: con_lims
--| output.var: lims_ids

SELECT
  s.LabSampleID as recipient_code
  , 1 as in_lims
FROM  dimSample s
INNER JOIN dimProject p ON s.ProjectKey = p.ProjectKey
WHERE (p.Project LIKE 'V-25W016%' OR p.Project LIKE 'V-26W012%')
```

### Installations

```{sql}
--| connection: con_gw
--| output.var: gw_fieldwork

WITH sampling_visits AS  (
  SELECT 
    SV.location_id
    , SV.sampleunit_id
    , SV.visit_done
    --, recipient_code
    , CASE 
        WHEN SV.recipient_code = '26-08679' THEN '26-008679' 
    --    WHEN SV.grts_address = '35039538' THEN NULL
        ELSE SV.recipient_code 
      END as recipient_code
  FROM  "inbound"."SamplingVisits" SV
  INNER JOIN "outbound"."FieldCalendars" FC
  ON SV.fieldcalendar_id = FC.fieldcalendar_id
  WHERE NOT SV.issues
  AND SV.visit_done
  AND NOT FC.excluded
)

SELECT 
  ST_AsText(LOC.wkb_geometry) AS wkb_geometry
  , LOC.grts_address
  , IV.stratum
  , IV.date_visit as installation_date
  , COALESCE(SUM(CAST(SV.visit_done as INT)), 0) as nr_visits
  , TRUE AS is_installed
  , CASE WHEN SUM(CAST(SV.visit_done as INT)) > 0 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS is_sampled
  , IV.watina_code_used_1_peilbuis
  , IV.watina_code_used_2_piezometer
  , SV.recipient_code
FROM "metadata"."Locations" LOC
INNER JOIN "inbound"."InstallationVisits" IV
ON LOC.location_id = IV.location_id AND LOC.grts_address = IV.grts_address
INNER JOIN "outbound"."FieldCalendars" FC
ON IV.fieldcalendar_id = FC.fieldcalendar_id
LEFT JOIN sampling_visits SV
ON IV.location_id = SV.location_id AND IV.sampleunit_id = SV.sampleunit_id
WHERE NOT IV.issues
AND IV.visit_done
AND NOT FC.excluded
GROUP BY 
  LOC.wkb_geometry
  , LOC.location_id
  , LOC.grts_address
  , IV.stratum
  , IV.sampleunit_id
  , IV.date_visit
  , IV.watina_code_used_1_peilbuis
  , IV.watina_code_used_2_piezometer
  , SV.recipient_code
ORDER BY is_sampled
```

### Combined reporting table

```{r}
gw_basetable <- gw_fieldwork |> 
  inner_join(
    gw_types,
    by = "stratum"
  ) |> 
  inner_join(
    rep_types,
    by = "type"
  ) |> 
  inner_join(
    gw_domains,
    by = "grts_address"
  ) |> 
  left_join(
    lims_ids,
    by = "recipient_code"
  ) |>
  replace_na(list(
    in_lims =  0
  ))
```

```{r}
gw_locevals_by_group <- gw_locevals |> 
  inner_join(
    rep_types,
    by = "type"
  ) |> 
  inner_join(
    gw_domains,
    by = "grts_address"
  ) |> 
  group_by(
    typegroup_name, domain_name
  ) |> 
  summarise(
    nr_locevals = sum(loceval),
    nr_approved_locevals = sum(loceval_approved)
  )

gw_installations_by_group <- gw_basetable |> 
  group_by(
    typegroup_name, domain_name
  ) |> 
  summarise(
    nr_instalations = n(),
    nr_visits = sum(nr_visits),
    nr_available_in_lims = sum(in_lims)
  )

gw_numbers <- gw_locevals_by_group |>
  left_join(
    gw_installations_by_group,
    by = c("typegroup_name", "domain_name")
  ) |> 
  arrange(typegroup_name, domain_name) |> 
  replace_na(list(
    nr_instalations = 0,
    nr_visits = 0,
    nr_available_in_lims = 0
  ))
```

# Surface water fieldwork

```{sql}
--| connection: con_surf
--| output.var: surf_samples

SELECT 
  ---LV.*
  ST_AsText(LOC.wkb_geometry) AS wkb_geometry
  , LOC.grts_address
  , LV.sampleunit_id
  , LV.stratum
  , LV.date_start
  , LV.date_visit
  , LV.log_user
  , LV.notes
  , sampling_done
FROM "metadata"."Locations" LOC
INNER JOIN "inbound"."VisitsUnnested" LV
ON LOC.location_id = LV.location_id AND LOC.grts_address = LV.grts_address
INNER JOIN "outbound"."FieldCalendars" FC
ON LV.visit_id = FC.visit_id AND LV.fieldcalendar_id = FC.fieldcalendar_id
WHERE NOT LV.issues
AND LV.visit_done
AND NOT FC.excluded
-- AND sampling_done -- (is always true??)
ORDER BY grts_address, stratum
```

### Locevals by scheme

```{r}
locevals_sf <- all_locevals |>
  filter(!is.na(wkb_geometry)) |>
  st_as_sf(wkt = "wkb_geometry", crs = 31370)

scheme_colors <- c(
  "GW_03.3"          = inbo_groen,
  "SOIL_03.2"        = inbo_roze,
  "SURF_03.4_lentic" = inbo_blauw
)

scheme_shapes <- c(
  "GW_03.3"          = 15,  # square
  "SOIL_03.2"        = 17,  # triangle
  "SURF_03.4_lentic" = 16   # circle
)

# Rarest scheme last -> plotted on top, so it isn't hidden by the others
scheme_order <- all_locevals |>
  count(scheme) |>
  arrange(desc(n)) |>
  pull(scheme)

locevals_sf <- locevals_sf |>
  mutate(scheme = factor(scheme, levels = scheme_order)) |>
  arrange(scheme)
```


### Surface water

A visit is defined as the combination of stratum-location-date (e.g.: as
on one day the same location is sampled for mutiple strata, this is
counted as multiple visits)

```{r}
kaart_sf <- surf_samples |>
  filter(!is.na(wkb_geometry)) |>
  group_by(grts_address, wkb_geometry) |>
  summarise(n_visits = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  st_as_sf(wkt = "wkb_geometry", crs = 31370)
```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 4
#| fig-width: 8

plot_surface_water_visits <- ggplot() +
  # Laag 0: Omtrek en provinciegrenzen van Vlaanderen
  geom_sf(
    data = vlaanderen_provincies,
    fill = "white",
    color = "grey55",
    linewidth = 0.35
  ) +
  # Laag 1: SBZ-H gebieden

    data = sbz_h,
    fill = "grey75",
    color = "grey75",
    alpha = 0.25,
    linewidth = 0.25
  ) +
  # Laag 2: Lentic visits, sized by number of visits at the same location
  geom_sf(
    data = kaart_sf,

    # alpha = 0.8

    plot.margin      = margin(8, 8, 8, 8),
    legend.position  = "bottom"
  ) +
  guides(
    size = guide_legend(
      title.position = "top",
      label.position = "bottom"
    )
  )
```

# LIMS linkage

## Approved sampling visits

```{sql}
--| connection: con_gw
--| output.var: sampling_visits

SELECT
  SV.sampleunit_id,
  SV.location_id,
  SV.grts_address,
  SV.date_start,
  SV.date_visit,
  SV.stratum,
  SV.project_code AS project_code_fieldwork,
  --recipient_code
  CASE
    WHEN SV.recipient_code = '26-08679' THEN '26-008679'
  --  WHEN SV.grts_address = '35039538' THEN NULL
    ELSE SV.recipient_code
  END AS recipient_code
FROM "inbound"."SamplingVisits" AS SV
INNER JOIN "outbound"."FieldCalendars" AS FC
  ON SV.fieldcalendar_id = FC.fieldcalendar_id
WHERE NOT SV.issues
  AND SV.visit_done
  AND NOT FC.excluded
ORDER BY SV.date_visit DESC
```

```{r}
gw_sampling_overview <- sampling_visits |>
  summarise(
    nr_visits = n(),
    nr_locations = n_distinct(grts_address),
    nr_missing_recipient_codes = sum(is.na(recipient_code))
  )
gw_sampling_overview
```

## Lims data

```{sql}
--| connection: con_lims
--| output.var: data_lims

WITH RankedResults AS (
    SELECT 
      r.Project
      , s.LabSampleID
      , r.Customer
      , s.FieldSampleID
      , s.FieldSamplingDate
      , s.FieldObserver
      , r.Component
      , u.Unit
      , r.Result as OriginalResult
      , TRY_CAST(REPLACE(r.Result, ',', '.') AS FLOAT) AS Result
      , CASE
          WHEN r.Component = 'NH4' THEN 0.776
          WHEN r.Component = 'NO3' THEN 0.226
          WHEN r.Component = 'PO4' THEN 0.326
          ELSE 1.0
        END AS ConversionFactor
      , r.isBelowLOQ
      , cmp.LOQ
      , CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(cmp.LOQ, '<', ''), ' ', ''), ',', '.') AS FLOAT) AS LOQValue
      , s.SampleStatus
      , r.ResultStatus
      , p.ProjectStatus
      , s.SampleType
      , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
          PARTITION BY r.Project, s.LabSampleID, r.Component
          ORDER BY 
              p.ProjectStatus DESC,   -- MIN ProjectStatus (bijv. 'V' boven 'C')
              s.SampleStatus ASC,  -- MAX SampleStatus (bijv. 'A' boven 'C')
              r.ResultStatus ASC   -- MAX ResultStatus (bijv. 'A' boven 'E')
        ) AS rn
    FROM dimSample s 
    LEFT JOIN factResult r ON r.SampleKey = s.SampleKey 
    INNER JOIN dimProject p ON r.ProjectKey = p.ProjectKey 
    INNER JOIN dimComponent cmp ON r.ComponentKey = cmp.ComponentKey 
    INNER JOIN dimUnit u ON r.UnitKey = u.UnitKey 
    WHERE (r.Project LIKE 'V-25W016%' OR r.Project LIKE 'V-26W012%')
      --AND r.ResultStatus != 'X'
      AND r.Component IN ('NH4', 'NO3', 'PO4', 'SO4')
      AND (s.SampleType IS NULL OR s.SampleType in ('Project'))
      AND r.IsReportable = 1
)
SELECT 
  Project as project_code_lims
  , LabSampleID as recipient_code
  , Component
  --, rn
  , CASE
      WHEN Component = 'NH4' THEN 'N-NH4'
      WHEN Component = 'NO3' THEN 'N-NO3'
      WHEN Component = 'PO4' THEN 'P-PO4'
      ELSE Component
    END as chem_variable
  , ProjectStatus
  , SampleStatus
  , ResultStatus
  , Customer
  , FieldSampleID
  , FieldSamplingDate
  , FieldObserver
  , Unit as unit
  , OriginalResult
  , Result
  , CASE 
      WHEN isBelowLOQ = 1 
      THEN LOQValue 
      ELSE Result 
    END * ConversionFactor AS value
  , isBelowLOQ
  , LOQ
  , LOQValue
  , 'available' as in_lims
FROM RankedResults
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY Project, LabSampleID, Component
```

## Combined data

```{r}
data_chemical_variables <- sampling_visits |> 
  inner_join(
    data_lims,
    by = c("recipient_code")
  ) |> arrange(
    in_lims,
    recipient_code
  )
```

Are there samples with negative values (should be zero)?

```{r}
data_chemical_variables |> 
  filter(value <= 0)
```

```{r}
base_chem <- data_chemical_variables |> 
  inner_join(
    gw_types,
    by = "stratum"
  ) |> 
  inner_join(
    rep_types,
    by = "type"
  ) |> 
  inner_join(
    gw_domains,
    by = "grts_address"
  )

base_chem <- base_chem |> 
  group_by(
    typegroup_name, domain_name, grts_address, stratum, chem_variable, unit
  ) |> 
  summarise(
    value = mean(value),
    nr_obs = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    domain_name = factor(
      domain_name,
      levels = c(
        "Kalmthoutse Heide",
        "Turnhouts Vennengebied",
        "Mechelse Heide",
        "Voerstreek",
        "De Maten",
        "Overig SBZ-H",
        "Overig Vlaanderen"
      )
    )
  )

base_chem_filtered <- base_chem |> 
  group_by(typegroup_name, domain_name, chem_variable) |> 
  filter(n() >= 2) |> 
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
base_chem |> 
  group_by(domain_name) |> 
  summarize(
    nr_obs = n_distinct(grts_address)
  )
```

```{r}
domain_colors <- c(
  "Kalmthoutse Heide"      = "#0072B2",
  "Turnhouts Vennengebied"  = "#56B4E9",
  "Mechelse Heide"         = "#CC79A7",
  "Voerstreek"             = "#009E73",
  "De Maten"               = "#E69F00",
  "Overig SBZ-H"           = "#F0E442",
  "Overig Vlaanderen"      = "#999999"
)

domain_labels <- c(
  "Kalmthoutse Heide" = "Kalmthoutse\nHeide",
  "Turnhouts Vennengebied" = "Turnhouts\nVennengebied",
  "Mechelse Heide" = "Mechelse\nHeide",
  "Voerstreek" = "Voerstreek",
  "De Maten" = "De Maten",
  "Overig SBZ-H" = "Overig\nSBZ-H",
  "Overig Vlaanderen" = "Overig\nVlaanderen"
)

chem_variable_labels <- c(
  "N-NH4" = "Ammonium (N-NH4)",
  "N-NO3" = "Nitraat (N-NO3)",
  "P-PO4" = "Fosfaat (P-PO4)",
  "SO4" = "Sulfaat (SO4)"
)

theme_chem <- function() {
  theme_bw() +
    theme(
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "right"
    )
}

get_legend_labels <- function(data) {
  counts <- data |> 
    group_by(domain_name) |> 
    summarize(
      nr_obs = n_distinct(grts_address)
    )
  
  # Format as "Domain Name (n = XX)"
  labels <- paste0(counts$domain_name, " (n = ", counts$nr_obs, ")")
  names(labels) <- counts$domain_name
  return(labels)
}

add_observation_counts <- function(plot_data, by_typegroup = FALSE) {
  if (by_typegroup) {
    plot_data |>
      count(typegroup_name, chem_variable, domain_name, name = "nr_observations")
  } else {
    plot_data |>
      count(chem_variable, domain_name, name = "nr_observations")
  }
}

plot_chem_var <- function(data, selected_variables = NULL) {
  plot_data <- data
  if (!is.null(selected_variables)) {
    plot_data <- data |> 
      filter(chem_variable %in% selected_variables)
  }
  
  ggplot(
    plot_data, 
    aes(x = domain_name, y = value, fill = domain_name)
  ) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 1.2, alpha = 0.8) +
    scale_y_log10(labels = label_number()) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = domain_colors,
      labels = get_legend_labels(plot_data),
      name = "Domein"
    ) +
    facet_wrap(
      ~ chem_variable,
      scales = "free_y",
      labeller = labeller(chem_variable = chem_variable_labels)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = "Chemische variabelen per domein",
      x = NULL,
      y = "concentratie (mg/l)"
    ) +
    theme_chem()
}
```

```{r}
plot_list <- base_chem_filtered %>%
  group_by(typegroup_name, .drop = TRUE) %>%
  group_split() %>%
  set_names(map_chr(., ~ as.character(unique(.x$typegroup_name)))) %>%
  map(~ {
    current_typegroup <- unique(.x$typegroup_name)
    
    plot_chem_var(.x) +
      labs(subtitle = current_typegroup)
  })
```

```{r}
#| label: save-plots
#| include: false

plot_output_dir <- "vorapas_output"
dir.create(plot_output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

save_report_plot <- function(plot, filename, width, height, dpi = 300) {
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(plot_output_dir, filename),
    plot = plot,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    dpi = dpi,
    bg = "white"
  )
}

safe_plot_filename <- function(name) {
  name |>
    str_to_lower() |>
    str_replace_all("[^[:alnum:]]+", "_") |>
    str_replace_all("^_|_$", "")
}

report_plots <- list(
  "groundwater_installations_samples.png" = plot_gw_installations_samples,
  "locevals_by_scheme.png" = plot_locevals_by_scheme,
  "locevals_by_scheme_facets.png" = plot_locevals_by_scheme_facets,
  "surface_water_visits.png" = plot_surface_water_visits,
  "chemistry_overall_distribution.png" = plot_chem_overall,
  "chemistry_nitrogen_distribution.png" = plot_chem_selected
)

report_plot_dimensions <- tibble(
  filename = names(report_plots),
  width = c(8, 8, 8, 8, 9, 9),
  height = c(4, 4, 11, 4, 6, 6)
)

iwalk(report_plots, \(plot, filename) {
  dimensions <- filter(report_plot_dimensions, filename == !!filename)
  save_report_plot(
    plot,
    filename,
    width = dimensions$width,
    height = dimensions$height
  )
})

iwalk(plot_list, \(plot, typegroup_name) {
  save_report_plot(
    plot,
    paste0("chemistry_by_typegroup_", safe_plot_filename(typegroup_name), ".png"),
    width = 9,
    height = 6
  )
})

iwalk(plot_list_selected_var, \(plot, typegroup_name) {
  save_report_plot(
    plot,
    paste0("chemistry_nitrogen_by_typegroup_", safe_plot_filename(typegroup_name), ".png"),
    width = 9,
    height = 6
  )
})
```

```{r}
prepare_table_for_google_sheets <- function(data) {
  data |>
    mutate(
      across(
        where(\(column) inherits(column, "integer64")),
        as.character
      )
    )
}

if (nzchar(google_sheet_id)) {
  googlesheets4::gs4_auth()
  iwalk(tables_to_export, \(data, sheet_name) {
    googlesheets4::sheet_write(
      data = prepare_table_for_google_sheets(data),
      ss = google_sheet_id,
      sheet = sheet_name
    )
  })
} else {
  message("Set VORA_PAS_GOOGLE_SHEET_ID to write report tables to Google Sheets.")
}
```
